mechanism_narrative: A continued rise in TRANSIT mobility signals increasing out-of-home activity, which lifts retail and recreation footfall, so RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT continues to rise week-on-week but the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean, the transit-led recovery mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Normalization of GROCERY_PHARM toward baseline indicates that essential-trip routines are stabilizing, freeing household mobility for discretionary retail trips, so RETAIL_REC will rise over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains above -12 but RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean does not exceed last 14-day mean, the essential-trip normalization mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: Cooler autumn weather in Delhi reduces heat avoidance and raises PARKS visits, and adjacent outdoor leisure activity spills over into retail and recreation, so RETAIL_REC will rise over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses above -60 percent change baseline
failure_condition: If PARKS stays above -60 for the next week yet RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is not higher than last 7-day mean, the seasonal outdoor-activity mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: As RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below its recent plateau, fewer people are staying home, and this release of residential containment increases retail and recreation trips over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 11 percent change baseline
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL is below 11 at the next weekly reading but RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is lower than or equal to last 14-day mean, the stay-at-home decline mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES indicates that commuting and public movement are reopening together; this coordinated activation pulls RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve over the next two weeks while RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean, the joint commuting-and-transit reopening mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous recovery in GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT reflects broad mobility normalization, not just essential travel, and this interaction predicts higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT both rise week-on-week for two weeks but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean does not exceed last 28-day mean, the joint normalization mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where TRANSIT rises week-on-week, eased movement constraints translate into more discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: In the reopening regime, if TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is lower than or equal to last 14-day mean, the regime-conditional easing mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above 10 percent indicates residual stay-at-home caution that suppresses discretionary outings, so RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 10 percent change baseline for two weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above 10 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean, the residual stay-at-home drag mechanism is rejected.
